mechanism: Meloxicam (NSAID) inhibits renal prostaglandin synthesis and may reduce renal clearance of atomoxetine, while atomoxetine is a noradrenergic agent that can increase blood pressure; combined use increases cardiovascular and fluid retention risks.
action: Monitor blood pressure regularly, assess renal function periodically, and consider alternative analgesia (acetaminophen) if possible; ensure adequate hydration and monitor for signs of fluid retention.
